description: JACKSONVILLE, N.C. — Senator Michael Lazzara (R–Onslow) joined military leaders, veterans, community members, and local officials Friday for the ribbon-cutting ceremony of the Carolina Museum of the Marine, which officially opened to the public today after more than 25 years of planning and development. title: NEWS: Lazzara Joins Local Leaders for Ribbon Cutting of Carolina Museum of the Marine
